اشتعلن (form VIII)
# اِشْتَعَلْنَ (ištaʕalna) /iʃ.ta.ʕal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# اُشْتُعِلْنَ (uštuʕilna) /uʃ.tu.ʕil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
# اِشْتَعِلْنَ (ištaʕilna) /iʃ.ta.ʕil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِشْتَعَلَ (ištaʕala)
